title: Filter Life Ended
fullDescription:
C1 alerts when the HEPA or carbon filter has reached 6 months / 2000 hours of use. Replacement is required to maintain CADR.

LG PuriCare towers use multi-stage filters sold by model.

title: Pre-Filter Clean Reminder
fullDescription: C2 reminds users to vacuum or rinse the washable pre-filter every 2-4 weeks. This extends HEPA life.

fixSteps.title: Wash or vacuum
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse and air-dry fully before reinstalling.

title: Dust Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Laser dust sensor reading abnormal values.
fullDescription: dS indicates the PM2.5 laser sensor is obstructed or faulty. Clean the sensor port.

fixSteps.title: Clean port
fixSteps.instruction: Use compressed air or cotton swab on sensor inlet.

title: Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: Dual-fan PuriCare reports stall on one fan.
fullDescription: FM indicates one of the two fan motors in the PuriCare 360 is not operating correctly. Check both fans for obstruction.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fans
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and check top and bottom fans.

faq.q: Can I run on one fan?

title: Wi-Fi Error
fullDescription: WF indicates lost Wi-Fi connection. Purifier works but ThinQ app is offline.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Wi-Fi button and follow ThinQ setup.

title: Auto Mode Off
fullDescription: AU means auto mode is unavailable due to sensor fault (dS).

title: Child Lock
fullDescription: CH indicates child lock is active. Hold lock button 3 seconds to disable.

title: UV Lamp Failure
fullDescription: UV code on UVnano-equipped models indicates the UV lamp has failed. Purification continues via HEPA.

fixSteps.title: Replace lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Order UV lamp module and install per manual.

whenToCallPro: If UV lamp not user-replaceable on your model.

title: High Particulate Warning
fullDescription: PM warning shows when airborne particulate levels are high. Unit goes to turbo. Identify source (cooking, smoke).

title: Filter Cover Open
fullDescription: dR prevents operation until the filter cover/base is locked. Reseat firmly.

fixSteps.title: Re-lock cover
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure base rotates to locked position.

faq.a: Yes, match indicator arrows on base.
